blocks.x: Retail banks fight on experience and cost per account: onboarding friction, service resolution and cross-sell precision decide share of wallet. The machinery underneath, decisioning, document intelligence, contact platforms, is where Achala IT Solutions engineers advantage. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in account opening and kyc, payment disputes and exceptions, contact-center resolution, with collections and hardship close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
For Retail & Consumer Banking, named from the floor, not from a framework:

items: Onboarding abandonment
Account opening abandons at KYC and document stages; manual checks take days while fintechs approve in minutes. Drop-off concentrates exactly where policy risk is highest.
Contact center deflection trap
IVR and chatbots deflect volume but not intent; repeat contact and CSAT decay while cost per contact climbs. Agents inherit escalations without context.
Single customer view missing
Deposits, cards, loans and interactions live in product silos; next-best-action and vulnerability detection both guess.
Account-takeover industrialized
Credential stuffing, SIM-swap and social engineering beat static MFA; fraud losses concentrate in digital channels.
Back-office exception queues
Payment exceptions, branch cash discrepancies and standing-order errors route to operations queues that grow with volume.
Branch and channel estate costs
Branch, ATM and app estates carry fixed costs without unit telemetry; nobody can state cost per transaction by channel.
